title: Block An IP Address From The Website | Brilliant Directories Documentation | BD Support
content: Block An IP Address From The Website Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/12000008504 To block an IP from the website, follow these steps: Access the cPanel dashboard by navigating to Developer Hub - cPanel Dashboard : **Important Note: The cPanel dashboard layout is continuously being updated, however, all the instructions presented in this article apply in the same way. We recommend using the keyword search tool to find specific sections: Search For "IP Blocker":" Enter the IP address that needs to be blocked: After this process is complete, the IP Address entered should populate like this: If the IP address is listed under " Currently-Blocked IP Addresses " the IP has successfully been blocked from accessing the website. For additional assistance: Email support@brilliantdirectories.com or create a ticket Inside Your Account Dashboard . Was this article helpful and accurate?
